Volunteers & Events quick start

Volunteers & Events 2.1, 2026-10-05

Use it to plan events, fill volunteer jobs, record who came and their hours, and keep track of gifts from supporters. Everything saves as you type. There is no Save button.

Open it

Option A: the shared page (best for a team). Open the NAMI landing page, press Open Volunteers & Events, and sign in to Claude if it asks. Everyone the link is shared with sees the same records, and a change shows up for everyone within a few seconds. You can make changes only if the link was shared with you as an Editor. If the top right says View only, ask Jesse to change your access.

Option B: the file (no account, no internet needed). Double-click Volunteers-and-Events.html and it opens in your web browser. Everything is saved in that browser on that computer, so keep using the same computer and the same browser.

The words at the top right say where your work is saved. The first time, a short welcome offers Show me around, a five-stop tour of the tabs. Skip it if you like; it is always under More → Settings.

The first five minutes

  1. Add an event. Tap Events, then New event, and type a name. Add the date, times and place when you know them.
  2. Add the jobs. On the event, tap Add a job. Name it (Greeter, Setup, Food table) and enter how many people it needs. A job that still needs people shows a soft yellow "spots open" label.
  3. Add the people. Under a job, type a volunteer's name and press Enter. Someone new is saved to your Volunteers list for you.
  4. Keep a to-do list on the event. Type a to-do, press Enter, and tick it off when it is done.

After an event

  1. Open the event. Next to each person, tap Came or Didn't come, or tap Everyone came to mark them all at once. Hours fill in from the event times. Type a different number to change one person's hours.
  2. More → Volunteer hours adds up everyone's hours for any dates. Copy for a spreadsheet lets you paste the table into Excel or Google Sheets.

Supporters and gifts

  1. Tap Supporters, then New supporter, then Add a gift. Choose money, food or goods, or time. Mark it Promised, then change it to Received when it arrives.
  2. More → Gifts shows money received, money promised, and every gift of food, goods or time.

Good to know

  • Made a mistake? Tap Undo in the message at the bottom of the screen. To get back something you deleted, go to More → Recently deleted and tap Bring back.
  • Have a list of volunteers already? Go to Volunteers → Add many at once and paste one person per line, like Name, phone, email.
  • Want to try it first? Use More → Settings → Add example records. They are marked "Example", and Remove the example records takes them all out again.
  • Bigger text or dark colors: More → Settings.
  • Back up now and then: More → Backup → Save a backup file. You need this most with the file version (Option B).
  • Keep out: health or diagnosis information, background-check reports, ID numbers and bank details.
